largest insured value of catastrophe losses recorded in Canadian history

series of devastating wildfires started in Los Angeles, which quickly spiralled out of control due to drought conditions and strong winds. The event is expected to trigger material losses to Syndicate 1910 and considering the uncertainty involved, a reliable estimate of associated outflows cannot be made. However, this is not expected to impact the going concern of Syndicate 1910. As the event occurred after the balance sheet date, the technical provisions included in these financial statements do not contain any estimates in relation to the wildfires.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported an overall release of GBP 45.340 million in prior year reserves for 2024, representing a 10.12% reduction of opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development, specifically good experience on longer tail and specialty classes for the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years. However, this was partially offset by a strengthening for the 2022 year of account reinsurance to close, which accounted for multi-year exposure to the devastating Los Angeles wildfires in January 2025.
